summary: Implementation plan for the Basic CRM college-level full-stack web application. Covers full MERN/Express architecture, User/Lead/Activity/FollowUp/Contact/Deal data flows, role-based access for Admin/Sales Manager/Sales Executive, controlled React forms with Context API, search/filter/pagination, dual-mode data persistence, and student submission tools (ER diagram viewer, Postman collection exporter, and test credentials).
